anomalies.description: Large-scale violent unrest involving police in riot gear and protesters, including use of crowd-control weapons (e.g., projectile launcher visible at f0–f5), physical confrontation (e.g., officer grabbing protester at f7–f9), and deployment of smoke/tear gas (f14–f16).

A police officer is seen physically restraining a protester (wearing yellow vest) by grabbing their arm and pulling them backward while the protester appears non-resisting; this occurs amid a larger clash but the specific interaction shows disproportionate force against a single individual.

A group of protesters in yellow vests raises arms in unison against a graffitied wall, followed by a sudden cluster of individuals surrounding and attending to a person on the ground, suggesting escalation or injury during unrest.

A person is lying on the ground with their shirt pulled up, revealing a large bruise or injury on their abdomen; others are gathered around, some appearing to assist, but the context and visible injury suggest prior physical abuse.

A person is holding a firearm equipped with a red-dot sight; the sight displays an illuminated red reticle, indicating the weapon is aimed and potentially ready to fire. The context suggests a live-fire or training scenario.

Large group of people in yellow vests engaged in violent unrest on a city street; smoke and apparent crowd clashes visible, with police or security forces present and deploying what appears to be tear gas or water cannon.; Individual wearing yellow vest holding French flag amid heavy smoke, consistent with ongoing riot conditions; posture suggests protest under duress or confrontation.
